meta.title: Calcalou: Calorie & Protein Tracker — tell Lou what you ate
meta.description: Track calories and protein with Lou. Snap a meal for AI estimates, scan barcodes for free and keep your streak. Free on iPhone, iPad and Android.
meta.og_title: Tell Lou what you ate. Lou does the counting.
meta.og_description: The calorie and protein tracker with a friend inside. Free on iPhone, iPad and Android.
hero.lead: Calcalou is the calorie and protein tracker with a friend inside. Snap or type a meal, see what's left for today and keep your streak going.
hero.fine: Free on iPhone, iPad and Android
hero.bubble: Hi, I'm Lou! What's on the plate today?
features.title: Snap. See. Streak.
features.sub: Most calorie counters feel like spreadsheets. Calcalou feels like a game you actually want to come back to.
f1.title: A photo is all it takes.
f1.text: AI photo recognition turns your meal into an estimate in seconds: calories plus protein, fat and carbs for each food, all editable. Prefer typing or a barcode? Add it by hand or scan the code, both free.
f1.tag: Premium · up to 50 scans a day
f1.alt: Add Entry screen: 540 kcal for a salad, with a Scan a photo button
f2.title: Eaten, burned, what's left.
f2.text: Track eaten and burned calories in one place. Set a daily calorie goal for a deficit, maintenance or a surplus, add a protein goal, and see what's left at a glance.
f2.alt: Today screen: 2,320 kcal left, 1,780 eaten, 2,100 burned, goal 2,000
f3.title: Log daily. Level up.
f3.text: Every day you log keeps your streak alive, earns XP and unlocks achievements. Hit a milestone and share the card with friends.
f3.alt1: Achievements screen: Level 11, 12 of 20 badges unlocked
f3.alt2: Milestone card: 30 days, a whole month
f4.title: Your week, summed up.
f4.text: A weekly summary shows your average intake, average burn and the days you hit your goal. Stats zoom out to the whole month.
f4.alt1: Weekly summary: average consumed and burned, 7 of 7 days logged
f4.alt2: Stats for last month with weekly bars
moods.title: Lou has feelings too.
moods.sub: Lou reacts to what you log, celebrates your streaks and gently nudges you when you skip a day.
more.title: Plays nicely with your phone.
more.widgets.d: Today's calories or protein on your Home Screen, plus Lock Screen widgets on iPhone.
more.siri.d: Ask Siri to record a meal, scan food or tell you what's left (iPhone).
more.health.d: Calcalou adds your daily calories and shows your active energy from them.
more.sync.d: Your diary lives in your account: a new phone brings your history, streaks and levels.
more.lang.d: Including English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish and Ukrainian.
more.privacy.d: Your food log is never sold.
faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.free.a: Yes. Logging calories and protein, barcode scanning, water, goals, streaks, levels, achievements and stats are free. Calcalou Premium unlocks AI photo scans, up to 50 a day, and removes ads. Where offered, an account can try up to 3 free scans once.
faq.lou.a: Lou is the little character who lives in the app. Lou reacts to what you log, celebrates your streaks and gently nudges you when you skip a day.
faq.accuracy.a: Photo scans give a quick estimate, not a lab measurement. All calorie figures in Calcalou are estimates. It is a wellness app, not a medical device: talk to a doctor or a registered dietitian before making big changes to your diet.
faq.devices.q: Which devices does it work on?
faq.devices.a: iPhone, iPad and Android phones. Continue with Apple (iPhone and iPad), Google or email, and your diary, streaks and levels sync between devices.
faq.data.a: Your food log is your data and is never sold. You can delete your account and all its data at any time.
final.title: Lou's waiting at the counter.
final.alt: Lou cheering with both paws up behind the counter
footer.disclaimer: Calcalou is a food and calorie logging app for general wellness, not a medical device. Calorie figures, including AI photo estimates, are estimates only.
sticky.ios: Get Calcalou on the App Store
more.water.d: Tap a glass or add a custom amount in ml without changing your glass size.
more.reminders.d: Set several reminders, each with its own time and days of the week.
more.export.d: Download a CSV for the month, quarter, year or all time.
protein.title: Protein, right beside your calories.
protein.sub: Set a daily protein goal and follow it next to your calories on Today.
protein.c1.t: A goal from your body weight
protein.c1.d: Calcalou multiplies your weight by grams per kilogram and shows the maths: 72 kg × 1.2 g/kg = 86 g. Adjust it from 0.8 to 2.0 g/kg or enter your own. Not medical advice.
protein.c2.t: Protein for every food in a photo
protein.c2.d: AI photo scans estimate protein, fat and carbs for each food next to calories. Edit any value before you save; estimates can be wrong.
protein.c3.d: Scan a barcode or type calories and protein yourself, both free. Product data varies, so check the label.
faq.protein.a: Yes. Log protein with every entry, set a daily goal from your body weight or enter your own, and see it next to calories. AI photo scans estimate protein, fat and carbs for each food; barcodes and manual entries are free. Estimates can be wrong, so check labels when it matters.
